main_text.p: & 3/12. Deinde ut facilior numeratio sit, pro inuentis partibus per secundam reductionem ad integra, sumes 6,4. & 3. Totus igitur e mensurarum numeris erit 13. Tum vero multiplica 36,16 & 15, per suarum mensurarum numeros, 6.4 & 3, facies 216, 64 & 45: e quibus totus est 325. Quaestionem deniq; sic concludes:
13 unciae aromatis mixti ualent 325; ergo 1 unicia ualet 25 3/13.
main_text.head: CAPVT XXVII.
De proportione multiplici terminis continuata.
main_text.p: PROPORTIO multiplex composita haftenus tractata est: supereft terminis continuata.
Proportio multiplex terminis continuata est, quando datarum rationum disiunctis terminis proportionales alij respondent, quorum medius quilibet antecedentem rationem cum consequente continuat.
In posteriore enim ordine datae rationes subsesquialtera,

page.notes: The initial P is a large woodcut initial, joined to the word PROPORTIO as printed. Some words in the top lines are partly obscured by the binding and print-through; the readings "sumes", "ualent" and the fraction forms are approximate. The line after "tera," is not followed by further text on this page.
